---
title: "Comparing ME inequalities across groups"
subtitle: "Example 4.3.a of Mize and Han (2025): models fit on different samples"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

When different samples are used for each model -- different groups, or
different time periods -- the `groups` option must be specified. Here the
question is whether religious-tradition differences in willingness to let a
gay man speak in public were larger before 1980 than after 2010.

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
use "https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/cda_gss", clear
drop if missing(spkhomo, reltrad, age, woman)

logit spkhomo i.reltrad c.age i.woman if year < 1980, vce(robust)
est store premod

logit spkhomo i.reltrad c.age i.woman if year >= 2010, vce(robust)
est store postmod

meinequality reltrad, models(premod postmod) groups unweighted
<</dd_do>>
```

The ME inequality estimate is significantly larger in the first model
(pre-1980) than in the second (post-2010): religious traditions have converged
on this question. `unweighted` compares the marginal effects alone; the
default weighted version would also reflect the change in the religious makeup
of the GSS between the two periods.
